name: gabriel-operator
description: Interview a user and author a local Gabriel AI Persona draft: page copy, lists, pipeline, optional team-agent graph, and optional review-only workflow.

interface.longDescription: A skills-only Codex plugin that interviews you and authors a local Gabriel AI Persona draft: chat page copy, list schema, pipeline stages, optional team-agent graph, and optional review-only workflow. It writes local files for human review and does not publish, provision, authenticate, or call remote services.
defaultPrompt: Create a Gabriel AI persona draft from this description.
Define lists, pipeline stages, and chat copy for this persona.
Draft a team-agent workflow for this Gabriel persona.
